history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A close-up, high-angle shot focuses on a person's lower leg and foot, resting on a tiled floor. The skin exhibits significant abrasions and bruising, particularly around the ankle and the top of the foot, with dark, mottled patches indicating deep bruising or scabs. Some lighter, irritated skin is visible surrounding the damaged areas. The leg is hairy, and several small, dark marks, possibly minor abrasions or ink from tattoos, are scattered on the shin. To the left of the leg, the black metal cage and a portion of the base of an electric fan are visible, partially out of focus. The floor tiles are off-white and appear slightly worn, with visible grout lines. The lighting is somewhat harsh, casting subtle shadows and highlighting the texture of the skin and the floor. The overall mood is one of injury and discomfort, with a raw, unvarnished realism. The color palette is dominated by earthy skin tones, deep browns and purples of the bruises, and the neutral tones of the floor and fan.
